title: राजमहल का रहस्यमयी जादुई मोर! 🦚✨ #shorts
topic: सूखी नदी को फिर से बहाने के लिए नन्हे वीर का राजमहल के बंद कमरे में जादुई मोर ढूँढने का रोमांचक ट्रेलर।
description:
क्या नन्हा वीर राजमहल के गुप्त कमरे का ताला खोलकर जादुई मोर को ढूँढ पाएगा? क्या गाँव की सूखी नदी फिर से बहेगी? जानिए इस रोमांचक सफर की पूरी कहानी!
#KahaniPatang #HindiKahaniyan #MoralStories #Shorts

characters.Veer: 8-year-old Indian boy, round curious face, bright brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean build, wearing a bright yellow cotton kurta and knee-length blue dhoti
characters.Rajguru: 65-year-old Indian male, calm wrinkled face, kind dark eyes, long flowing white beard and hair, slim build, wearing an orange saffron robe with wooden bead necklace
characters.Peacock: An ancient carved wooden peacock figurine with glowing turquoise blue eyes, shimmering golden etched feathers, rustic Indian palace artifact look

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अगर राजमहल के बंद कमरे का ताला दस सेकंड में नहीं खुला... तो पूरे गाँव की नदी हमेशा के लिए सूख जाएगी!
scenes.style: Tense, urgent, high-stakes whispering narrating tone
scenes.visual: An 8-year-old Indian boy, round curious face, bright brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean build, wearing a bright yellow cotton kurta and knee-length blue dhoti, standing anxiously in front of a huge dusty ancient wooden door inside a dimly lit ancient Indian palace corridor.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: वीर! रुको... उस कमरे में वो जादुई मोर सदियों से बंद है! वहाँ जाना ख़तरनाक हो सकता है!
scenes.style: Deep, cautious, trembling elderly voice, warning with grave concern
scenes.visual: A 65-year-old Indian male, calm wrinkled face, kind dark eyes, long flowing white beard and hair, slim build, wearing an orange saffron robe with wooden bead necklace, holding a brass lamp, looking worriedly towards the boy in a palace hall.

scenes.speaker: C
scenes.text: लेकिन राजगुरु... अगर हमने जादुई मोर को आज़ाद नहीं किया, तो हमारी प्यासी नदी फिर से कभी नहीं बहेगी!
scenes.style: Brave, determined young boy's voice, slightly panting with determination
scenes.visual: An 8-year-old Indian boy, round curious face, bright brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean build, wearing a bright yellow cotton kurta and knee-length blue dhoti, reaching out his hand towards a glowing ornate keyhole on the ancient palace door.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: जैसे ही वीर ने ताले में चाबी घुमाई... ज़मीन ज़ोर-ज़ोर से काँपने लगी!
scenes.visual: Medium shot inside the ancient palace corridor, dusty stone floor shaking, bright light bursting from the door cracks as the giant doors slowly open.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: बच्चों, क्या आपको लगता है कि इस अँधेरे कमरे में छिपा मोर नदी में पानी वापस ला पाएगा?
scenes.style: Warm, engaging, asking kids curiously and warmly
scenes.visual: An ancient carved wooden peacock figurine with glowing turquoise blue eyes, shimmering golden etched feathers, rustic Indian palace artifact look, sitting high upon a carved stone pedestal surrounded by blue mist.

scenes.speaker: C
scenes.text: अरे वाह! देखो... यह तो चमकती आँखों वाला असली जादुई मोर है!
scenes.style: Excited, gasping in awe and wonder, amazed whisper
scenes.visual: An 8-year-old Indian boy, round curious face, bright brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean build, wearing a bright yellow cotton kurta and knee-length blue dhoti, looking up at the peacock with wide open eyes inside the secret room.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लेकिन तभी... मोर के पंखों से तेज़ नीली रोशनी निकली और कमरा बंद होने लगा!
scenes.style: Terrified, sudden sharp rise in tension, fast breathless tone
scenes.visual: High dynamic shot of the ancient secret room, bright turquoise light radiating from An ancient carved wooden peacock figurine with glowing turquoise blue eyes, shimmering golden etched feathers, rustic Indian palace artifact look while stone walls shift.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: वीर... जल्दी करो! बाहर निकल आओ, रास्ता बंद हो रहा है!
scenes.style: Shouting out of breath, terrified warning voice
scenes.visual: A 65-year-old Indian male, calm wrinkled face, kind dark eyes, long flowing white beard and hair, slim build, wearing an orange saffron robe with wooden bead necklace, waving his arms anxiously near the narrowing door opening.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्या वीर जादुई मोर को लेकर सही सलामत बाहर निकल पाएगा?
scenes.style: Suspenseful cliffhanger voice, intense low whisper
scenes.visual: An 8-year-old Indian boy, round curious face, bright brown eyes, short messy black hair, lean build, wearing a bright yellow cotton kurta and knee-length blue dhoti, sprinting towards the closing gap holding the glowing wooden peacock.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आगे क्या हुआ? पूरी कहानी देखने के लिए नीचे दिए गए वीडियो पर क्लिक करें!
scenes.visual: Wide cinematic shot of the grand ancient Indian palace under a bright golden sky with a dusty dry riverbed in the foreground.
